content:
elaine: dropping notes from today's quick sync about the nav IA iteration. main goals: reduce top-level noise, make product paths predictable for deep links, and ensure a smooth deprecation for old slugs. putting the mock + routing sketch here.

rafael: high level ack. can you summarize the new top-level groups? i want to make sure the mobile collapse works too.

elaine: new top-level: Home, Apps, Platform, Billing, Help. under Apps -> Workloads -> Models | Serving | Jobs. Platform contains Settings, Telemetry (moved), Integrations. rationale: Apps is app-scoped stuff; Platform is org/global stuff.

claire: copy nit: "Workloads" might be ambiguous for non-engineer PMs. can we use "Compute" or "Workloads (Compute)"?

josh: prefer "Workloads" for parity with docs. if we change name we need doc updates. maybe use a hover tooltip that says "Compute & running resources".

may: a11y / keyboard notes: 1) group headers must be reachable via tab and have aria-expanded. 2) when opening an item via deep link, focus should land in page-level H1, not on the side nav. 3) announce breadcrumb changes to assistive tech. also respect reduced-motion for the group expand animation.

accessibility-bot: recommended aria: role="navigation", aria-label="Main navigation"; breadcrumbs: aria-current="page" on last crumb; add visuaFocus class for high-contrast focus ring.

elaine: router sketch (implementation idea):
```
GET /apps/:appId -> App overview
/apps/:appId/workloads -> workloads list
/apps/:appId/workloads/models -> models list
/apps/:appId/workloads/models/:modelId -> model detail (deep link)
/platform/settings
/platform/telemetry
```
Also: deprecated routes mapping: /projects/:projectId/models -> redirect (302) -> /apps/:inferredApp/workloads/models.

rafael: how do we infer app? server lookup or client-side resolver?

josh: prefer server lookup for consistent canonical URLs. propose lightweight endpoint: POST /v1/resolve?modelId=xxx -> {appId, modelId}. fallback page when ambiguous.

claire: UX for redirect: show a small banner "You're being redirected to the new Console layout. View migration notes" with a link. give 30 days notice in-app + docs.

may: accessibility for the banner: role="status" and a dismiss button reachable via keyboard. ensure screen reader announces redirect message.

devops-bot: note: we should emit telemetry.event = {name: "legacy_route_redirect", legacy: "/projects/:id/models", dest: "/apps/:appId/workloads/models"} with counts for 90d.

elaine: good call. we'll add a migration plan: 1) add router aliases & 302 responses 2) add resolve endpoint 3) instrument redirect telemetry 4) announce via banner + docs + migration guide 5) after 90 days consider 410 for stale slugs.

rafael: one more routing detail: preserve query params on redirects (filters, search, uiState). don't drop pagination/state.

josh: implement redirect-preserve like: Location: /apps/123/workloads/models?search=foo&page=2 and return 302. server should merge/append query params.

claire: breadcrumb pattern question: should breadcrumb include group labels (Apps > Workloads > Models > Model X) or be minimal (App Name > Models > Model X)?

may: prefer App Name > Workloads > Models > Model X for clarity. ensure crumbs are links except last. provide skip-to-content link at top for keyboard users.

elaine: agreed. final UX asks for engineering: - router aliases for legacy slugs - resolve endpoint + cache - 302 redirects preserving queries - small announcement banner + dismiss - a11y checklist (may) - telemetry for redirects and deep-link opens

rafael: i'll take the routing PR and put the alias table in the PR body. let's include unit tests for redirect logic and e2e that verifies focus lands on H1 after deep link.

josh: i'll add server-side resolve endpoint and a caching layer. also will produce a short-lived audit log of resolved mappings for 30d.

may: i'll produce the a11y checklist and run keyboard nav tests (mac + voiceover) once there's a preview.

claire: i'll update the docs and the migration guide draft. will include CLI snippet for users of older CLI versions.

elaine: thanks team. i'll update the figma (link uploaded) and open the draft PR with routing table + alias map. pinging @rafael @josh @may for reviews. :thumbsup:
